A trace may PROPOSE a contract; only an entry here can change a status.
Every contract must be expressible without naming a program.

invariants: a created port names its creating task as owner
a created port owns an allocated signal bit, never bit zero by default
deleting a port releases the bit it names
only an explicitly bound destination may receive a pumped native message
a pumped message reaches exactly one guest destination
reply pairing is released exactly once
a process's own pr_MsgPort never receives native input
several windows may share one destination port
a context that never calls a blocking primitive must not starve its siblings
evidence_note: Observed: a child context polls a port tens of thousands of times and

the sibling that owns the input port. On real hardware preemption
